purpose: Boundedly determine whether the official Qwen3.8-27B FP8 artifact fits one B70 in proven eager mode at exact 8K, 4K, or 2K and publish every smaller exact-depth serving cell supported by the first successful service lifetime.

supersedes.relationship: R1 was never launched. R2 preserves its exact model, runtime, ladder, fixture, verifier, gates, and publication policy while correcting the startup budget from 0.98 to the evidence-supported 0.96 and assigning fresh identities.

r19.finding: gpu-memory-utilization 0.98 is impossible at the observed startup snapshot: 29.38 GiB free is below the 29.69 GiB requested budget; no weights or requests

r20.finding: gpu-memory-utilization 0.96 passes the startup guard and loads all weights, but the compiled profile leaves -1.09 GiB for KV cache

r21.finding: enforce-eager removes compile/graph residency and reaches healthy TP1 service; R21 used 0.968, while R2 deliberately retains the independently proven 0.96 startup/weight-load budget rather than importing opportunistic tuning

rebased_fit_evidence.frozen_conclusion: Only gpu-memory-utilization changes from R1: 0.98 to 0.96. Eager execution was already frozen in R1. No R21 concurrency, context, 0.968 budget, throughput, or other setting transfers.

model.verification: Immediately before locks and launch, every manifest weight must match publisher SHA-256 through strict O_DIRECT full-file reads and again through complete ordinary reads; no fallback direct mode is accepted.
model.download_policy: This packet never downloads, resumes, repairs, deletes, or renames model files.

runtime.classification: same pinned audited XPU nightly as R1 and R19-R21; immutable runtime base

strict_verifier_reused_exact.scope: model identity/readiness and strict O_DIRECT-plus-ordinary hashes only; its R1 campaign label does not transfer execution identity

failure_policy.startup_failure: Preserve logs and cleanup, then descend to the next arm regardless of classifier; only explicit allocation/capacity evidence is labeled fit failure.
failure_policy.receipt_or_correctness_failure_after_boo: Stop failed-invalid, preserve all artifacts, publish no cell from that lifetime, and do not reinterpret it as fit failure.
failure_policy.2k_explicit_fit_failure: Durable unsupported closure for official FP8 TP1 at active context >=2K under this exact runtime and memory contract; publish zero measured cells.
failure_policy.larger_explicit_fit_failure_then_smaller: Publish only the exact smaller Grade-C cells returned by the successful lifetime and retain larger depths as unsupported under this tuple.

publication.evidence_grade: C exact repeated-token serving shape with 128 returned token IDs and cache-zero gate; not natural prose
